nodes.title: SG-6.2 · Accessible Radix dialogs for Intro and Contribution
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet already renders inside the shadcn-style Radix wrapper in game/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx and returns focus to the Suggest trigger through returnFocusRef. IntroScreen is still a plain <section> with a Frame, so it has no dialog role, no focus trap and no Escape handling. Desired behaviour: both overlays are Radix dialogs from ui/dialog.tsx, with keyboard focus trapped inside, focus returned to the trigger on close where a trigger exists, and Escape closing. Expected result: tests assert all of this. Why: SG-6 requires keyboard-accessible overlays without changing what the player sees or can do.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the intro is shown, when it renders, then IntroScreen exposes role dialog built from ui/dialog.tsx and Begin still calls onBegin once
- Given the intro dialog is open, when Escape is pressed, then it closes by calling onBegin once and the player enters the game as with Begin
- Given the intro dialog or contribution dialog is open, when Tab is pressed on the last control or focus is moved outside, then focus stays inside the dialog
- Given the contribution dialog is open, when it closes through Escape or Close, then focus returns to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/IntroScreen.tsx
- In scope: ContributionSheet focus and Escape behaviour tests
- In scope: IntroScreen focus trap and Escape tests
- Out of scope: SG-6.3 splitting ContributionSheet, AdminApp and App
- Out of scope: backend/ and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: new features, content or art changes
- Preserve: Intro text, Begin button and parchment look
- Preserve: ContributionSheet form, validation, quota and history behaviour
- Preserve: frontend/src/api/client.ts endpoints and payloads


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests that pinned internals are rewritten against behaviour
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Both dialogs use ui/dialog.tsx
- Tests assert trap, focus return and Escape for both
- Typecheck and tests pass in game/frontend


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessibility: dialogs have an accessible name and description


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · IntroScreen is an accessible Radix dialog built on ui/dialog.tsx
nodes.body:
Context: IntroScreen.tsx (22 lines) renders section.intro-screen.sf-fullscreen-bg containing a Frame and a Begin Button. Desired behaviour: keep the section backdrop, render the story in Dialog/DialogContent with sf-frame-parchment sf-dialog classes, give it an accessible name and description, and treat dialog close (Escape) as onBegin. Expected result: role dialog with trapped focus. Why: keyboard and screen reader users get a proper modal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given IntroScreen is rendered, when queried by role, then one dialog with an accessible name exists containing the four story lines and a Begin button
- Given the dialog is open, when Escape is pressed, then onBegin is called exactly once
- Given the dialog is open, when Begin is clicked, then onBegin is called exactly once


## Scope
- In scope: IntroScreen.tsx
- Out of scope: ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: App gate logic
- Preserve: Intro wording
- Preserve: gold Begin button
- Preserve: full-screen backdrop section


## Technical constraints
- Use components/ui/dialog.tsx, no new dialog primitive
- No change to what the player sees
- Source files stay under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- IntroScreen uses Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle and DialogDescription
- Escape and Begin both call onBegin


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessible name and description present, no Radix missing-description warning


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · ContributionSheet traps focus, closes on Escape and returns focus to its trigger
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet wraps its content in DialogContent with onCloseAutoFocus returning focus to returnFocusRef; Escape and focus return are tested, but the focus trap is not. Desired behaviour: the existing Radix behaviour is confirmed in code and the focus trap is asserted by tests. Expected result: trap, Escape and focus return all covered. Why: closes the SG-6.2 done-when for the contribution sheet.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open, when Tab is pressed on the last tabbable control, then focus moves to the first tabbable control inside the dialog
- Given the sheet is open, when focus is moved to an element outside it, then focus returns inside the dialog
- Given the sheet closes through Escape, then focus is on the Suggest trigger


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet dialog structure and focus props
- Out of scope: Splitting ContributionSheet below 200 lines (SG-6.3)
- Out of scope: form validation changes
- Preserve: history, quota, validation and submit behaviour
- Preserve: returnFocusRef prop


## Technical constraints
- Use components/ui/dialog.tsx
- API client endpoints and payloads unchanged
- Tests mock only the API client, Phaser and the network


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- All interactive controls sit inside DialogContent
- Focus return wired through onCloseAutoFocus and returnFocusRef


## Non-functional requirements
- Keyboard operable


## Clarifying questions
- None
